slides.slide_title: Introduce l-clusters: bl cl fl gl pl sl

content_payload.front_text: bl  cl  fl  gl  pl  sl

slides.teacher_cue: This lesson makes explicit a pattern you have already used in many words. L-clusters: a consonant followed immediately by l, before a vowel. bl (blend, black), cl (clap, clean), fl (flag, flat), gl (glad, glow), pl (plan, play), sl (slim, slip). No vowel between the two consonants — blend them cleanly together.
slides.expected_response: Students identify and produce all six l-clusters without vowel insertion.
slides.correction_move: Drill each cluster in isolation: bl-bl-bl, cl-cl-cl, fl-fl-fl, gl-gl-gl, pl-pl-pl, sl-sl-sl. Students produce the cluster before hearing the full word.
slides.observation_note: Watch for vowel insertion — Korean learners may produce buh-lack instead of black. This is the primary cluster interference pattern.

slides.teacher_cue: Say black — the darkest colour. bl cluster onset. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say black orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model black orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for vowel insertion between b and l — must blend cleanly.

slides.teacher_cue: Clap your hands. Say clap — cl cluster. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say clap orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model clap orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for cl onset — no vowel between c and l.

slides.teacher_cue: Say flag — a piece of cloth on a pole. fl cluster. Confirm /f/ not /p/. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say flag orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model flag orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /p/ on /f/ and for fl cluster — no vowel insertion.

slides.teacher_cue: Say glow — to emit light. gl cluster, ow vowel team. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say glow orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model glow orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for gl onset and /oʊ/ in ow.

slides.teacher_cue: Say plan — a scheme or design. pl cluster. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say plan orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model plan orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for pl onset — no vowel between p and l.

slides.teacher_cue: Say slim — thin. sl cluster. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say slim orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model slim orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for sl onset and short /ɪ/ vowel.

slides.correction_move: Return to oral segmenting, then rebuild one sound at a time.
slides.observation_note: Watch for correct cluster placement — no vowel insertion.
